entities.summary: Kuok Khoon Hong is a Singaporean business magnate, entrepreneur and philanthropist, often referred to as the “Palm Oil King” He is the co-founder, chairman and CEO of Wilmar International, having built it into one of Asia's leading agribusiness groups, and the world's largest palm oil trader. He is also the co-founder and chairman of Yihai Kerry, and the non-executive chairman of Adani Wilmar Ltd. He has an estimated net worth of US$3.7 billion as of January 2021.
